tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams skor bzhugs so// bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ zhu ba/ khyed dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ sku khams bzang zhing 'gro don rgya che/ gdul bya longs spyod nam mkha' dang mnyam par bzhugs nas yod cing thos pas sems shin tu dga'/ nga rgan mo da lta 'tshams po yod/ skabs zhu/ khyed dbus gtsang na 'gro don che yang nga la ma phan/ ma bu 'brel ba rmi lam tsam du 'dug go /nga ni rgas/ mi tshe stong par zad/ 'chi ba ma dran 'chi khar chos med pas/ khyed mdo rgyud yon tan thams cad la mkhas kyang*/ nga la lam ston mi med/ nga rgan mo nam 'chi dus phan nges shes pa'i gdams pa zab mo gcig zhu/ mdo phyogs kyi rgyu mtshan dge bshes yon tan rin chen la gsal/ zhu yig mi 'khyar ba'i rten du dngul spo re gsum bskur yod/ yos lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyer lnga la phul// ༈ a ma byang chub 'bum gyi yi ge rten dang bcas pa 'phrod/ khyed sku khams bzang po yod 'dug pa legs/ nged kyang dge sbyor la brtson par yod/ na ning dge bshes/ grags pa/ bzang po gsum la yi ge rten dang bcas pa bskur ba byung yod las che/ a ma/ khams gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin/ de las thar bar 'dod na/ rang dbang gang yod kyi rgyu rnams dge phyogs su gtong zhing chos zab mo ston pa'i bla ma la sgom khrid zhus/ a ma nged kyis gsungs pa'i chos nyams su lon pa dka'/ las rgyu 'bras 'di bden par go zhing mig can g.yang la mchongs pa rnams rang gis rang slu ba yin te/ de la skyon chen po yod par the tshom med/ skyes nas 'chi bar thag chod par shes bzhin du rnam smin gyi dal 'byor mi lus stong log byas nas 'chi chos mi dran pa rnams 'o re brgyal/ 'gyod de 'chi/ tshe 'di'i sgrib pa shas chung zhing*/ tshe snga ma'i rnam smin gyis ma bsgribs na/

nged rang ma bu gnyis bde 'gro thob nges pa'i lam gcig 'tshol thabs yod pas 'di bzhin thugs la bzhag 'tshal// *༈ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun gyis grub// khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che// de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang bsgom// yid rtse gcig 'dun pas gsol ba thob// lus tsog pu skyil krung gang bde 'am// de ma grub gzhogs g.yas 'og tu chug /gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar// rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba smyug tsam// steng spyi gtsug skar khung thal le ba// sgo ma 'gags gsal le yod pa la// sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril// tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar bsgom// de sog sbug yungs kar phu btab bzhin// de the tshom med par rgyangs te thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs/ phaṭaḥ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun gyis grub// khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol// sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// snying brtse bas yang yang bskyangs pa'i ma// sgos tshe 'di'i dal 'byor mi lus 'di// chos byang chub sgrub pa'i rten du byin// drin 'khor thabs med pa'i a ma la// bus sgyu lus kyis zhabs tog ma grub kyang*// de'i drin lan dam pa'i chos kyis 'jal// 'di ma brjed thugs kyi dkyil du zhog /lar skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin// 'di rgan gzhon khyad par med na yang*// sgos tshe zhabs nub ri'i nyi ma bzhin// dus 'chi bas gtugs pa rgas pa'i chos// da lo zla tsam gyi tshe gzhug na// mas chags sdang gsog long mi 'dug pas// rje bla mas gsungs pa'i gdams ngag dang*// don rang sems gcig tu bsres mdzod cig

/nor sdig dang 'dres pa'i gsog 'jog la// rang lus ngag yid gsum 'bad bton nas// sems yi dwags sa bon 'debs pa yang*// 'di spyir na spong ba nyung bar gda'// da gsog na sgo gsum dge ba'i las// tshe phyi ma'i nor skal gsog par zhu// mi mtho dman 'bring gsum kun la yang*// rang 'gyod pa med par bstun na yang*// de mgu ba nyung la 'khang pa mang*// da mi sems 'dzin pa'i spros pa shol// blo nang du khug la rang gi sems// don lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyal sa zungs// rang lto gos kyi sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas// dus yun ring bskyangs pa'i bu tsha yang*// lus rang mgo khyog nas drin bzhag byed// 'di sdug bsngal yin gyi rgyab tu skyur// las grub dang ma grub rtsis gdab shol// blo rnam rtog chags sdang ling gis skyur// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che// de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang bsgom// yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba thob// lus tsog pu skyil krung gang bde 'am// de ma 'grub gzhogs g.yas 'og tu chug /gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar// rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba lcag tsam// steng spyi gtsug skar khung thal le ba// sgo ma 'gags gsal le yod pa la// sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril// tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar bsgom// de sog sbug yungs kar phu btab bzhin// de the tshom med par rgyangs kyis thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /de lan gcig ma yin yang yang skyor// lus sems dang bral dus dgos pa yin// dus da lta dmigs pa goms su chug /chos khyad par 'phags pa'i man ngag 'di// ma drin can sems kyi skyo rogs mdzod// bka' mdo rgyud kyi snying po bsdus nas phul// bu yid la dran tshe 'di la gzigs// nga mdun na yod kyang 'di las med// dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs// sems dag snang ngang du yang yang mjal// zhes pa 'di mtshungs pa med pa'i rong ston chen pos drin can a ma la gdams pa rdzogs so//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
